contract: Controlled keyed grid,selectedKeys and selectionEnabled. Four columns,80dp cells,15dp padding,8dp gaps,source header and toolbar. Drag starting on unselected item unions the start/end range with the baseline; starting on selected item subtracts from the baseline. Reversing direction retracts only the current range. Tap toggles one item. Cancellation/background restores baseline and stops auto-scroll. Edge regions60dp scroll300dp/second using frame clock,matching source3points/10ms while avoiding its stale timer direction. Grid order is host-owned; stable unique string keys required,reserved __tenk_header prohibited. Share/delete emit selected keys only; no data is deleted. Host owns durable selection. Gallery uses45deterministic samples from original9color palette instead of random reshuffling. Swift color gradients,blurReplace,snappy curves,thin material and physical/iOS pixel/motion parity remain unverified.
visual: host render inspected; iOS comparison unverified
remaining: Original glass,fonts,exact motion and physical/iOS comparison
